question: Two nuclei $X$ and $Y$ have total binding energies $E_X$ and $E_Y$ respectively. It is observed that $E_X > E_Y$, yet nucleus $Y$ is found to be more stable than nucleus $X$. State the logical conclusion that explains this observation.

options.A: Nucleus $X$ has a larger atomic number than $Y$.
options.B: The binding energy per nucleon of $Y$ is greater than that of $X$.
options.C: Nucleus $Y$ has more neutrons than protons.
options.D: The electrostatic repulsion in $X$ is zero.
